A real 896-second scan of the real /Users/zhengfengqing requires a process with genuine host filesystem access at real human/interactive timescale. No AutoLoop-orchestrated path found in this repo grants that (every container path explicitly excludes $HOME from its mount allowlist; the one LLM-driven adapter that could grant real host access is not wired to any production caller). The most consistent explanation is a Pi session run directly against the host — an interactive agent session outside any code in this repository — which is also consistent with the Controller's own description of Pi as a separately-operated agent runtime, and with how this very VCA-1 card exchange has been conducted (cards delivered as text, executed by an agent with real host tool access, not through any committed AutoLoop pipeline code).
